correctness.rationale: The primary paper's Assumption4 says ⟨b_k(x),x−x*⟩≤η⟨Q(x),x−x*⟩, but its Lemma1 uses this as a lower bound to derive ≥µ(1−η)||x−x*||². With x*=0 and b=-2x, the printed condition holds (-2x²≤0) yet Q+b=-x reverses descent. The projected recursion gives x1=1 and xk=1 forever. The source's differentiability/compact convex set/strong convexity/quasi-gradient linear-growth/boundedness/zero-noise hypotheses are satisfied. Independent exact rational replay ran 20 steps, showing no rate decay. The correct sufficient sign for the specific contraction line is ⟨b,d⟩≥−η⟨Q,d⟩, coupled with a separately valid Q lower bound; no full replacement theorem is claimed.
